nodes.label: Gradle Settings (settings.gradle.kts)
nodes.rationale: Configures plugin repositories (Google, Maven Central, Gradle Plugin Portal), enables foojay-resolver toolchain convention, and declares the single :app subproject.

nodes.label: App Module Build Script (app/build.gradle.kts)
nodes.rationale: Configures Android SDK 36, Jetpack Compose, Room via KSP, Hilt DI, DataStore, Navigation, and kotlinx-serialization. Defines the ISpend app's full dependency graph.

nodes.label: FinanceApp (Hilt Application)
nodes.rationale: @HiltAndroidApp entry point enabling Hilt dependency injection across the application lifecycle.

nodes.label: TransactionSearchResult (JOIN Projection)
nodes.rationale: Room-mapped projection from a JOIN between transactions and categories tables, used for search results that carry denormalized category fields.

nodes.label: DailyTotal (Aggregation Result)
nodes.rationale: Data class for GROUP BY date SUM(amount) query results.

nodes.label: AppModule (Hilt DI Module)
nodes.rationale: Dagger/Hilt @Module installed in SingletonComponent that provides Room database, all DAOs, and binds repository implementations to their domain interfaces.
